free_text_notes.physician_note: 68-year-old woman with hypertension, asthma, admitted 5/24 with left lower lobe pneumonia with small parapneumonic effusion. Leukocytosis resolved; tolerating diet. Pulse oximetry briefly read 94 percent during a deep sleep period overnight. Daytime readings have consistently been above 96 percent and no clinical concern was raised.
